dispositions.assessment: The intended profile is the accepted Windows-x64/SSE single-precision operation evaluation. The old i686 x87 compilation retained excess precision across expressions/inlined locals and produced context-dependent words. Conditional NARROW stores through an addressable volatile float only when FLT_EVAL_METHOD is nonzero; otherwise it is the original expression. It is applied at float-operation/assignment boundaries in placement/cross products, local normalization/magnitude helpers, speed/sweep, radius boxes and city offsets. Constants, operators, order, branches, staged services, refusals and output shape stay the same.
dispositions.clean_code: Narrowing is local to this kernel rather than changing shared eech_arith.h or global compiler flags. Local helper bodies correspond to the existing shared/original algorithms; no separate physical solver, policy, fallback or cache is introduced. Macro operands are pure reads and evaluated once.
dispositions.x64_identity_limit: The macro expands as identity for the declared x64 evaluation model, with the local helper operations preserving the old source semantics. This is not a binary/object-code identity claim. Retained patched x64 original-C control and x64 candidate differential are exact; new Windows builds and literal actuals remain mandatory.
dispositions.FP_RNG_boundary: Explicit x87 float stores can change internal rounding/status relative to old excess precision; that is the intended portability repair. Existing kernel FP guard and exception-mask requirement are unchanged and enclose the computations; no new global FP setting/RNG/callback/order change. No new universal32-bit caller-FP or historical32-bit MSVC proof is inferred.
dispositions.oracle_integrity: The existing Rust differential oracle/assertions are unchanged except explanatory comments. No tolerance, normalization, skip, golden rewrite, seed/input change or primary compiler FP flag was used to make it pass.
